Description.DefaultValue: Electrical load calculation, panel schedule and study tools.

bt:String.DefaultValue: Open the SAZAN PowerCalc tab to build load calcs, panel schedules and studies.
Go To Load Calc — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Adds one row to the Load Calc section your cursor is in — works on any of the twelve sections.
Removes empty rows from the bottom of the Load Calc section your cursor is in.

Switches a Load Calc section off or back on. A section that is off collapses out of view and drops out of every roll-up — the panel space counter, the service load summary, and the generator and UPS matrices. Choose 0 to switch every section back on.
New Utility Demand (12 mo) — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Go To Utility Demand — SAZAN PowerCalc.
New Logging Demand (30 day) — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Go To Logging Demand — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Add rows to a Load Calc, Generator or UPS table — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Trim rows from a Load Calc, Generator or UPS table — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Transformers — new transformer schedule or jump to the existing one. SAZAN PowerCalc.
Go To Short Circuit — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Go To Voltage Drop — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Go To Arc Flash — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Go To Feeder Schedule — SAZAN PowerCalc.
Go To Combined Studies — the read-only view joining Feeder Schedule, Short Circuit and Voltage Drop by bus.
Recalculate and validate the Feeder Schedule — it derives its own rows from the equipment registry.
Rebuild the Arc Flash bus table — Short Circuit and Voltage Drop derive themselves and are not modified.
